verdict.rationale: Notte is an AI-powered SaaS browser-automation platform, so a data-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a training policy, opt-out control, or no-training guarantee. Adjacent features do not count toward this story: vault credentials hidden from LLMs, bring-your-own-keys, and isolated sessions are related controls, not a commitment that user data won't be used to train models.
